svg.text: The residual stream in 2D (real models: thousands of dimensions)
1. The stream is a running sum
each block adds one arrow, nothing is overwritten
The thick purple segment is the projection
2. LayerNorm: keep the direction, fix the norm
applied to a copy of the stream, before each sublayer
Rescaling keeps the direction; mean removal, γ and β rotate it slightly.
The stream h keeps its norm: only its copy LN(h) is rescaled.
3. Attention: read LN(h), add the result to h
layer 3 acts on the h of panel 1: it reads LN(h), writes one vector
4. MLP: read LN(h′), write new features
acts on this token's stream only, via neurons that read and write
points along the direction it reads, then writes its
